judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation after completing only the first two facets of its plan. While it added `ajv` to dependencies and implemented schema compilation at `ToolRegistry.register` time, it never actually modified `ToolRegistry.execute` to run the compiled `validateInput` function or return a rejection `ToolResponse`. Consequently, 3 out of the 4 acceptance tests added by the candidate in `registry.acceptance.test.ts` fail immediately, and unused-property/lint rules would likely fail on the unread `validateInput` field. It also missed dynamic schema caching via `WeakMap`, several required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the doc comment on `execute`, and all documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`).
